subject: MSN - how to change shape of nodes?

messages.author: 8ce694d5545e48a5
messages.subject: MSN - how to change shape of nodes?
parts:
Hello,

I am building Bruvo MSNs with populations sampled from different crops, crops are defined by color palette as populations in the network. I attached the graph to this post for clear representation.

I also have data referring to the genetic clusters each of the individuals in each population belongs. There are total of two clusters defined by Structure across all sampled populations. 

I would like to additionally visualize these clusters on the network by a node shape (can be any shape, for example, cluster 1 is a circle, cluster 2 is a square). This way I would still have my network colored by population, but also nodes would be shaped by genetic cluster defined by Structure.

Could you please help to find out if there is a way to do it?

Thanks a lot

Olga

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] MSN - how to change shape of nodes?
parts:
Hi Olga,

A bit surprisingly, having pie nodes with different shapes is a bit of a challenge with igraph. You may be able to get away with giving the border of the nodes different shades as detailed in the igraph documentation: http://igraph.org/r/doc/vertex.shape.pie.html

If your groups segregate well, another option is to use the mark.groups parameter: http://igraph.org/r/doc/plot.igraph.html 

All of these parameters can be passed via poppr's plotting functions.

Hope that helps,
Zhian
